title: नेपाली शास्त्रीय सङ्गीतमा तण्डुकार घराना [Tandukar family in Nepali Classical Music]
nepali: नेपाली शास्त्रीय सङ्गीतको इतिहासमा तण्डुकार घरानाको भूमिका ठुलो छ । सङ्गीत क्षेत्रमा तण्डुकारहरू उस्तादको नामले चिरपरिचित छन् । काठमाडौँको भाँेसिकोटोल उस्तादहरूको उद्गमस्थल हो । खुसः जातले पनि परिचित यिनीहरूको मुख्य पेसा कृषि हो । कामारूकामाक्षबाट रातो मच्छिन्द्रनाथ बोकेर ल्याउने रथचक्र ललित ज्यापुलाई पूर्वज मान्ने तण्डुकारहरू जात्रापर्व, पूजापाठ, गीत सङ्गीततर्फ पनि दखल भएकाले लिच्छवी राजाले लालमोहर लगाई काः बाजा बजाउने अधिकार तण्डुकारलाई दिएका थिए । यद्यपि मच्छिन्द्रनाथको जात्रामा तण्डुकारहरूले सर्वप्रथम रथ तानेर उक्त जात्राको शुभारम्भ गर्ने चलन रहेको छ । यसरी संस्कृति र सङ्गीतकलालाई आत्मसात् गरी अगाडि बढेकाले नै यिनीहरू शास्त्रीय सङ्गीतप्रति आकर्षित भएका देखिन्छन् । यसैको परिणामस्वरूप गरिमामय घराना कायम गर्न सफल भएका हुन् । प्राप्त जानकारीअनुसार वीरभीमसेन american_english: The Tandukar gharana plays a major role in the history of Nepali classical music. In the field of music, the Tandukars are well-known by the title of Ustad. Bhansikotol in Kathmandu is the birthplace of the ustads. Also known by the caste name Khusah, their main occupation is agriculture. Regarding Rathachakra Lalit Jyapu, who brought Rato Machhindranath carrying him from Kamarukamaksha, as their ancestor, and because the Tandukars were also proficient in festivals, rituals, songs, and music, the Licchavi king affixed his red seal granting the Tandukars the right to play the Kah musical instrument. However, in the festival of Machhindranath, there is a tradition that the Tandukars are the first to pull the chariot, thereby initiating the procession. Having thus advanced by embracing culture and musical art, they appear to have been attracted toward classical music. As a result of this, they succeeded in establishing a prestigious gharana. According to available information, from a study of five to six generations from Vir Bhimsen Tandukar to Ustad Narayan Prasad Tandukar, it is understood that the Tandukars made contributions not only within the country but also abroad. The awards, certificates, medals, letters of appreciation, and song recordings they received from within the country and abroad—the role of the Tandukar gharana in the history of Nepali classical music is significant. Also known by the caste name Khusah, their main occupation is agriculture. These are the proofs confirming this context. This gharana has made a major contribution to producing teachers and professors currently serving and retired in schools and universities. Materials prepared by scientifically and systematically analyzing the contributions made by this gharana have not been available to this day. In-depth study and research on this subject does not appear to have been conducted. This itself is the major problem in this field. With the primary objective of studying the said field, establishing its identity, and addressing the problem, this article titled 'Tandukar Gharana and Nepali Classical Music' has been prepared.
